title: DoSync IntentResult
description: The outcome of executing an ActionPlan. Returned by GET /v1/intent/{intent_id}: while execution runs, status is 'pending' and the document carries the partial progress; once it ends, the outcome. Written to the tamper-evident audit log.

intent_id.description: Links this result back to the originating Intent.

success.description: True if all actions completed successfully. False if any action failed.

status.description: Execution outcome summary. 'success': all actions completed. 'partial': some actions failed, rest continued (failure_policy=continue). 'partial_abort': some executed, rest cancelled (failure_policy=abort). 'failed': all actions failed or intent was blocked by a policy. 'retry_exhausted': retries exhausted on at least one action (failure_policy=retry).

refused_proposals.description: Governed direct mode (spec §6 rule 7): the actions the agent proposed that the hub refused, never executed.

failed_devices.description: device_ids of devices whose action failed.

aborted_devices.description: device_ids of devices whose action was cancelled due to failure_policy=abort.

failure_policy_applied.description: The failure_policy that was active during execution.

intent.description: The intent class that was fired.

partial.description: While pending: the progress so far, so a pending result is never opaque.

actions_taken.description: Actions that ran, real or simulated.

actions_simulated.description: Of those, how many were simulated. A simulated action is always declared as such.

ActionResult.title: DoSync ActionResult
ActionResult.description: Outcome of a single DeviceAction execution.

response.description: Adapter-specific response data. Structure varies by device type.

error.description: Error message if success is false.

aborted.description: True if this action was cancelled by failure_policy=abort before it could execute.

simulated.description: True if no physical device acted: the action was simulated (no adapter, or certify mode). Never omitted when true.

retries.description: Number of retry attempts before this final result.

executed_at.description: Unix timestamp when this action was executed.
